items.claim: Jeremiah Wells is extremely explosive and can close space very fast.
items.quote: he can close space so fast that you never even seen it coming

items.claim: Jeremiah Wells is very good at attacking the neck and utilizing submissions in grappling exchanges.
items.quote: Jeremiah is really good with attacking the neck... and he has subs.

items.claim: Ramiz Brahimaj has good takedowns and good submissions.
items.quote: Ramiz has good takedowns, he has good submissions.

items.claim: Ramiz Brahimaj has pop on the feet.
items.quote: he definitely has pop on the feet as well.
